days.caption:
Buying in Dubai? Here's the whole process in 7 steps, from budget to keys 🔑

Save this for later and send it to someone who's planning to buy.

DM "BUY" for a free plan built around your budget.

#DubaiRealEstate #BuyInDubai #DubaiProperty #GoldenVisa #DubaiOffPlan
days.linkedin_caption:
Most first-time buyers in Dubai only budget for the price. The real cost is about 7–8% higher once DLD and agency fees are added.

Here's the full buying process in 7 steps, from setting a real budget to collecting the keys: ready vs off-plan, how escrow protects you, and what the SPA should say about handover and delays.

Save it for when you're ready, or send it to someone who is.

days.caption:
A 10-year UAE residence visa through property 🇦🇪
Who qualifies, what it covers, how to apply. Swipe →

DM "VISA" and I'll send you a shortlist of properties that qualify.

#GoldenVisa #UAEGoldenVisa #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Owning property worth AED 2 million or more in Dubai can qualify you for a 10-year, renewable UAE Golden Visa, covering your spouse and children too.

In the slides: the threshold, how off-plan and mortgaged homes are treated, who the visa covers and the application steps.

Rules change, so always confirm with DLD before buying specifically for the visa.

days.caption:
Dubai's next metro line opens in 2029 🚇 Here's where it runs and why it matters for property.

DM "METRO" for options along the route.

#DubaiMetro #BlueLine #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiInfrastructure #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
The Blue Line is a 30 km metro line linking nine districts, from Dubai Creek Harbour and Festival City to International City, Mirdif, Silicon Oasis and Academic City. It's due to open in 2029.

Historically, homes near new transit get easier to rent and resell. The time to look is before the trains run, not after.

days.caption:
Who's behind Dubai's biggest communities? A quick guide to the master developers 🏗️

DM "COMPARE" and I'll compare them for your budget.

#DubaiRealEstate #DubaiDevelopers #DubaiProperty #OffPlanDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Before you buy into a community, know the developer behind it.

A quick map of Dubai's master developers: the government-backed group under Dubai Holding, the big listed names, the Abu Dhabi arrival and the private builders, plus what each is known for.

Whoever it is, check the delivery record and RERA registration first.

days.caption:
Dubai in 1990 vs today. One generation, a different city 🌆

DM "NEXT" to find out where it's heading next.

#Dubai #DubaiHistory #DubaiSkyline #DubaiRealEstate #MyDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
In 1990, Dubai had about half a million people and Sheikh Zayed Road ran through open desert. Today it has more than 4 million residents and one of the world's busiest airports.

Every phase of that growth rewarded the people who bought early in the next area. The 2040 plan shows where the next one is.

days.caption:
60/40, 70/30, post-handover: what do they actually mean? 💰 Explained on a real AED 3M example.

DM "PLAN" and I'll match a plan to your budget.

#DubaiOffPlan #PaymentPlan #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Off-plan payment plans decide your cash flow for years, so it's worth understanding them properly.

On a AED 3M home: a 60/40 plan means about AED 1.8M during construction and AED 1.2M at handover. A 70/30 plan often comes with a better price, and a post-handover plan lets rent help with the payments.

Always check the plan's dates against the handover date in the SPA.

days.caption:
The Dubai 2040 Master Plan in 6 slides 🗺️ The government's roadmap for where the city grows next.

DM "2040" to see which communities sit closest to the growth centres.

#Dubai2040 #DubaiRealEstate #UrbanPlanning #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
The Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan is a 20-year roadmap: 5.8 million residents, six urban centres, double the open space and much more public beach.

For buyers, it works like a map of where infrastructure arrives first. The communities near the new centres and transit are the ones to watch.

days.caption:
Off-plan, ready, resale, secondary: what's the difference? 🏠 Four ways to buy, four different deals.

DM "TYPE" and I'll match one to your budget and timeline.

#DubaiRealEstate #OffPlan #DubaiProperty #BuyInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Off-plan, ready, resale, secondary: four terms that confuse most first-time buyers in Dubai.

The short version: off-plan is cheapest and slowest, ready is immediate, resale (also called secondary) is negotiable, and off-plan resale lets you buy closer to handover.

The right one depends on your budget and how soon you need the keys.

days.caption:
Every fee you pay when buying in Dubai, in one place 🧾 Save this before you make an offer.

DM "COSTS" for a full breakdown on the home you're looking at.

#DubaiRealEstate #DLD #BuyInDubai #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
The price is not the cost. On top of it come the 4% DLD transfer fee, the trustee office fee, agency fees on resale, mortgage registration and the developer NOC.

As a rule of thumb, budget 7–8% above the price for a ready home. The slides list each fee and who pays it.

days.caption:
Jebel Ali Beach: Dubai's longest public beach 🏖️ 6.6 km, three zones, mangroves and a 2 km swimmable stretch.

DM "BEACH" for the communities next to it.

#JebelAli #DubaiBeach #DubaiRealEstate #PalmJebelAli #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
Jebel Ali Beach is set to become Dubai's longest public beach: 6.6 km and 330 hectares under an approved masterplan, with a beach club, a turtle sanctuary, mangroves, a 2 km swimmable beach and a 5 km running track.

Beach access is one of the strongest drivers of rent and resale. The best time to buy near a new beach is before it opens.

days.caption:
How the UAE was born 🇦🇪 From the Trucial States and the 1968 handshake to 2 December 1971, in 7 slides.

Save it and share it with someone new to the UAE.

DM "UAE" if you're thinking of putting down roots here.

#UAE #UAEHistory #EidAlEtihad #DubaiRealEstate #AbuDhabi
days.linkedin_caption:
In 1968, the Trucial States were a set of small sheikhdoms under British protection, with oil only just starting to flow. Three years later they were one country.

A short history of how the UAE came together: the maritime truces of the 1800s, the oil discoveries of 1958 and 1966, the February 1968 agreement between Sheikh Zayed and Sheikh Rashid, and the declaration of the union on 2 December 1971.

55 years on, it's worth remembering how recent and how deliberate all of this was.

days.caption:
Dubai real estate in 24 years 📈 2002 freehold, the 2008 crash, golden visas and a record AED 917bn in 2025.

Save this for context the next time someone calls it a bubble.

DM "HISTORY" to talk about where the market goes next.

#DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty #UAE #InvestInDubai #DubaiHistory
days.linkedin_caption:
Until 2002, a foreigner couldn't own a freehold home in Dubai. In 2025 the market recorded more than 270,000 transactions worth AED 917bn.

What happened in between matters: the 2006 registration law, escrow and RERA in 2007, the 2008-09 correction, golden visas in 2019, and the run of records since.

The rules written after the crash are a big part of why today's market looks so different from 2008.

days.caption:
Dubai Metro: every line now and every line coming 🚇 Red, Green, the Blue Line in 2029 and the new 42 km Gold Line in 2032.

Save it for the next time you're comparing areas.

DM "METRO" for homes near the new stations.

#DubaiMetro #GoldLine #BlueLine #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
Dubai Metro carried 294.7 million trips in 2025, and the network is about to grow fast.

The Blue Line (30 km, 14 stations) opens in September 2029 and is already about 30% built. The Gold Line, approved in April 2026, adds 42 km underground from Al Ghubaiba to Jumeirah Golf Estates via Business Bay, Meydan and JVC, opening in 2032.

RTA itself estimates property near Gold Line stations could rise by up to 20%. Infrastructure usually gets priced in before the ribbon is cut.

days.caption:
Etihad Rail is here 🚆 Abu Dhabi to Dubai in about 57 minutes from AED 39, and a 30-minute high-speed line on the way.

Save it and tag someone who commutes between the two.

DM "RAIL" for homes near the stations.

#EtihadRail #UAE #Dubai #AbuDhabi #DubaiRealEstate
days.linkedin_caption:
Since 30 June 2026 you can take a passenger train across the UAE. Abu Dhabi to Dubai takes about 57 minutes, with fares from AED 39, and Dubai's Al Yalayis station connects to the metro at Jumeirah Golf Estates.

Next up is a dedicated high-speed line cutting Abu Dhabi to Dubai to about 30 minutes, with stations planned at Saadiyat, Yas, Abu Dhabi Airport and Al Jaddaf.

When a two-city commute becomes a 30-minute ride, it changes where people choose to live.

days.caption:
Abu Dhabi real estate just had its biggest year ever, in nine months 🏙️ AED 171bn from January to September 2026, up 76%.

Save it if you're weighing Abu Dhabi against Dubai.

DM "ABU DHABI" for a side-by-side comparison.

#AbuDhabiRealEstate #AbuDhabi #SaadiyatIsland #YasIsland #AlReemIsland
days.linkedin_caption:
Abu Dhabi recorded AED 171bn of real estate transactions in the first nine months of 2026, more than the whole of record-breaking 2025 (AED 142bn).

Al Reem, Al Hudayriyat, Saadiyat and Yas led by value. Foreign buyers made up 62% of residential sales value last year, and apartment prices rose 19%.

For a long time Abu Dhabi was Dubai's quieter neighbour. The numbers say that's changing.

days.caption:
Saadiyat and Yas: Abu Dhabi's culture and theme park capital 🏛️ Louvre, Zayed National Museum, the Guggenheim on 11 December, and Disneyland on the way.

Save this for your next Abu Dhabi weekend.

DM "SAADIYAT" for homes on Saadiyat and Yas.

#SaadiyatIsland #YasIsland #GuggenheimAbuDhabi #DisneylandAbuDhabi #AbuDhabiRealEstate
days.linkedin_caption:
In one year Saadiyat Cultural District added teamLab Phenomena, the Natural History Museum and the Zayed National Museum. On 11 December 2026, Frank Gehry's Guggenheim Abu Dhabi opens beside the Louvre.

Next door on Yas, Disney is planning its first Middle East park with Miral, and Sphere Abu Dhabi is due by the end of 2029.

This kind of anchor investment tends to show up in demand for homes nearby long before the doors open.

days.caption:
The seven rulers of the UAE 🇦🇪 Who leads each emirate, and since when, ahead of Eid Al Etihad.

Save it and share it with someone who's new to the UAE.

#UAE #EidAlEtihad #UAELeadership #SevenEmirates #DubaiRealEstate
days.linkedin_caption:
Ahead of Eid Al Etihad, a quick guide to how the UAE is led.

The rulers of the seven emirates make up the Federal Supreme Council, the country's highest authority. Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed is President and Ruler of Abu Dhabi. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid is Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai. Sheikh Dr Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi has ruled Sharjah since 1972.

Useful context for anyone new to the country, or anyone investing here.

days.caption:
Happy 55th Eid Al Etihad 🇦🇪 On 2 December 1971, six emirates became one nation. Here's the story of the day and the flag.

Eid Al Etihad Mubarak to everyone who calls the UAE home.

#EidAlEtihad #UAENationalDay #UAE55 #UAE #Dubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Today is the UAE's 55th Eid Al Etihad. On 2 December 1971, six emirates united at Union House in Dubai, and Ras Al Khaimah joined two months later.

The flag raised that day was designed by Abdullah Mohammed Al Maainah, aged 19, from about 1,030 entries. This year's celebrations centre on family, as part of the UAE's Year of Family.

Eid Al Etihad Mubarak to everyone who calls this country home.

days.caption:
Wall Street is moving to Al Maryah Island 💼 BlackRock, Blackstone, J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Brevan Howard and more now have a presence in ADGM.

Save it and send it to someone in finance.

DM "ADGM" for homes on Al Reem and Al Maryah.

#ADGM #AbuDhabi #AlMaryahIsland #AlReemIsland #AbuDhabiRealEstate
days.linkedin_caption:
ADGM ended H1 2026 with 13,974 active licences, a workforce of 49,027 (up 34%) and assets under management up 54% year on year.

The names on its register include BlackRock, Blackstone, J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Apollo, Brevan Howard and Marshall Wace. To keep up, Mubadala and Aldar have announced an AED 60bn+ expansion of Al Maryah Island that roughly doubles its Grade A office supply and adds 3,000+ homes.

Where the financial industry goes, demand for quality housing follows.

days.caption:
DIFC 2.0: the AED 100bn Zabeel District 🏦 17.7M sq ft, room for 125,000+ workers, and its first homes sold out at launch.

Save it and share it with someone who works in DIFC.

DM "DIFC" for early access to launches nearby.

#DIFC #ZabeelDistrict #DubaiRealEstate #Dubai #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
DIFC passed 10,000 active companies in H1 2026, and in January Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid launched its next chapter: Zabeel District, an AED 100bn+, 17.7M sq ft expansion with room for 42,000+ companies and 125,000+ workers.

Phase 1 (about AED 20bn) is due in 2029-30, with an AI Campus, a much larger DIFC Academy, hotels and homes. The first residential launch, The Residences (463 homes), sold out on launch day.

Dubai's two financial centres are expanding at the same time. That says a lot about where demand is heading.
